sentences.text_target: Arthur sat at his desk and stared at his computer screen with a worried expression.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːθə sæt æt hɪz dɛsk ænd steəd æt hɪz kəmˈpjuːtə skriːn wɪð ə ˈwʌrid ɪkˈsprɛʃən/
sentences.text_native: Arthur était assis à son bureau et fixait l'écran de son ordinateur avec une expression inquiète.

sentences.text_target: He had just sent a professional email to a close colleague regarding the upcoming marketing campaign.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː hæd ʤʌst sɛnt ə prəˈfɛʃənl ˈiːmeɪl tuː ə kləʊs ˈkɒliːg rɪˈgɑːdɪŋ ði ˈʌpˌkʌmɪŋ ˈmɑːkɪtɪŋ kæmˈpeɪn/
sentences.text_native: Il venait d'envoyer un e-mail professionnel à un proche collègue concernant la campagne marketing à venir.

sentences.text_target: However, after re-reading the text, he realized that the tone sounded surprisingly harsh.
sentences.phonetic: /haʊˈɛvə, ˈɑːftə ˌriːˈriːdɪŋ ðə tɛkst, hiː ˈrɪəlaɪzd ðæt ðə təʊn ˈsaʊndɪd səˈpraɪzɪŋli hɑːʃ/
sentences.text_native: Cependant, après avoir relu le texte, il s'est rendu compte que le ton semblait étonnamment dur.

sentences.text_target: The other person might easily misinterpret his message and assume he was angry.
sentences.phonetic: /ði ˈʌðə ˈpɜːsn maɪt ˈiːzɪli ˌmɪsɪnˈtɜːprɪt hɪz ˈmɛsɪʤ ænd əˈsuːm hiː wɒz ˈæŋgri/
sentences.text_native: L'autre personne risquait facilement de mal interpréter son message et de supposer qu'il était en colère.

sentences.text_target: Arthur certainly did not intend to upset anyone with his direct instructions.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːθə ˈsɜːtənli dɪd nɒt ɪnˈtɛnd tuː ʌpˈsɛt ˈɛniwʌn wɪð hɪz dɪˈrɛkt ɪnˈstrʌkʃənz/
sentences.text_native: Arthur n'avait certainement pas l'intention de contrarier qui que ce soit avec ses instructions directes.

sentences.text_target: He quickly decided that he needed to clarify his intent before the situation escalated.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈkwɪkli dɪˈsaɪdɪd ðæt hiː ˈniːdɪd tuː ˈklærɪfaɪ hɪz ɪnˈtɛnt bɪˈfɔː ðə ˌsɪtjʊˈeɪʃən ˈɛskəleɪtɪd/
sentences.text_native: Il a rapidement décidé qu'il devait clarifier son intention avant que la situation ne dégénère.

sentences.text_target: Opening a new reply window, he began typing an immediate apology.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈəʊpənɪŋ ə njuː rɪˈplaɪ ˈwɪndəʊ, hiː bɪˈgæn ˈtaɪpɪŋ ən ɪˈmiːdiət əˈpɒləʤi/
sentences.text_native: Ouvrant une nouvelle fenêtre de réponse, il commença à taper des excuses immédiates.

sentences.text_target: He wanted to reassure his coworker that the feedback was purely constructive.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈwɒntɪd tuː ˌriːəˈʃʊə hɪz ˈkəʊˌwɜːkə ðæt ðə ˈfiːdbæk wɒz ˈpjʊəli kənˈstrʌktɪv/
sentences.text_native: Il voulait rassurer son collègue en lui disant que les commentaires étaient purement constructifs.

sentences.text_target: Misunderstandings happen far too often when people rely solely on written communication.
sentences.phonetic: /ˌmɪsʌndəˈstændɪŋz ˈhæpən fɑː tuː ˈɒfən wɛn ˈpiːpl rɪˈlaɪ ˈsəʊli ɒn ˈrɪtn kəˌmjuːnɪˈkeɪʃən/
sentences.text_native: Les malentendus se produisent bien trop souvent lorsque les gens se contentent de la communication écrite.

sentences.text_target: Without facial expressions or vocal tone, emotional nuance is extremely difficult to perceive.
sentences.phonetic: /wɪðˈaʊt ˈfeɪʃəl ɪkˈsprɛʃənz ɔː ˈvəʊkəl təʊn, ɪˈməʊʃənl ˈnjuːɑːns ɪz ɪkˈstriːmli ˈdɪfɪkʌlt tuː pəˈsiːv/
sentences.text_native: Sans expressions faciales ni tonalité vocale, la nuance émotionnelle est extrêmement difficile à percevoir.

sentences.text_target: Different readers might perceive the exact same sentence in completely contrasting ways.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈdɪfrənt ˈriːdəz maɪt pəˈsiːv ði ɪgˈzækt seɪm ˈsɛntəns ɪn kəmˈpliːtli kənˈtrɑːstɪŋ weɪz/
sentences.text_native: Différents lecteurs peuvent percevoir exactement la même phrase de manières totalement opposées.

sentences.text_target: Arthur deleted the problematic sentence and rephrased his thoughts much more politely.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːθə dɪˈliːtɪd ðə ˌprɒblɪˈmætɪk ˈsɛntəns ænd ˌriːˈfreɪzd hɪz θɔːts mʌʧ mɔː pəˈlaɪtli/
sentences.text_native: Arthur a supprimé la phrase problématique et a reformulé ses pensées beaucoup plus poliment.

sentences.text_target: He added a friendly greeting at the beginning and a warm closing at the end.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈædɪd ə ˈfrɛndli ˈgriːtɪŋ æt ðə bɪˈgɪnɪŋ ænd ə wɔːm ˈkləʊzɪŋ æt ði ɛnd/
sentences.text_native: Il a ajouté une salutation amicale au début et une conclusion chaleureuse à la fin.

sentences.text_target: Before clicking send again, he checked every single detail of the attached document.
sentences.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔː ˈklɪkɪŋ sɛnd əˈgɛn, hiː ʧɛkt ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋgl ˈdiːteɪl ɒv ði əˈtæʧt ˈdɒkjʊmənt/
sentences.text_native: Avant de cliquer à nouveau sur envoyer, il a vérifié le moindre détail du document joint.

sentences.text_target: The project manager had asked for this updated version by the end of the afternoon.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈprɒʤɛkt ˈmænɪʤə hæd ɑːskt fɔː ðɪs ˈʌpˌdeɪtɪd ˈvɜːʃən baɪ ði ɛnd ɒv ði ˈɑːftənuːn/
sentences.text_native: Le chef de projet avait demandé cette version mise à jour avant la fin de l'après-midi.

sentences.text_target: Everything looked correct, so he finally transmitted the message successfully.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɛvrɪθɪŋ lʊkt kəˈrɛkt, səʊ hiː ˈfaɪnəli trænzˈmɪtɪd ðə ˈmɛsɪʤ səkˈsɛsfʊli/
sentences.text_native: Tout semblait correct, alors il a finalement transmis le message avec succès.

sentences.text_target: A few minutes later, his phone rang on the corner of his wooden desk.
sentences.phonetic: /ə fjuː ˈmɪnɪts ˈleɪtə, hɪz fəʊn ræŋ ɒn ðə ˈkɔːnər ɒv hɪz ˈwʊdn dɛsk/
sentences.text_native: Quelques minutes plus tard, son téléphone a sonné sur le coin de son bureau en bois.

sentences.text_target: It was his colleague calling directly to resolve the minor miscommunication.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz hɪz ˈkɒliːg ˈkɔːlɪŋ dɪˈrɛktli tuː rɪˈzɒlv ðə ˈmaɪnə ˌmɪskəmjuːnɪˈkeɪʃən/
sentences.text_native: C'était son collègue qui l'appelait directement pour résoudre ce petit malentendu.

sentences.text_target: They laughed about the initial wording and agreed on the next steps.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ lɑːft əˈbaʊt ði ɪˈnɪʃəl ˈwɜːdɪŋ ænd əˈgriːd ɒn ðə nɛkst stɛps/
sentences.text_native: Ils ont ri de la formulation initiale et se sont mis d'accord sur les prochaines étapes.

sentences.text_target: Arthur appreciated how quickly they managed to clear up the confusion.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːθə əˈpriːʃieɪtɪd haʊ ˈkwɪkli ðeɪ ˈmænɪʤd tuː klɪər ʌp ðə kənˈfjuːʒən/
sentences.text_native: Arthur a apprécié la rapidité avec laquelle ils ont réussi à dissiper la confusion.

sentences.text_target: This experience taught him to be much more careful with professional emails.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪkˈspɪəriəns tɔːt hɪm tuː biː mʌʧ mɔː ˈkeəfʊl wɪð prəˈfɛʃənl ˈiːmeɪlz/
sentences.text_native: Cette expérience lui a appris à faire beaucoup plus attention aux e-mails professionnels.

sentences.text_target: In the future, he would avoid sending abrupt phrases without proper context.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪn ðə ˈfjuːʧə, hiː wʊd əˈvɔɪd ˈsɛndɪŋ əˈbrʌpt ˈfreɪzɪz wɪðˈaʊt ˈprɒpə ˈkɒntɛkst/
sentences.text_native: À l'avenir, il éviterait d'envoyer des phrases brusques sans contexte approprié.

sentences.text_target: Whenever possible, he planned to discuss sensitive topics during a phone call instead.
sentences.phonetic: /wɛnˈɛvə ˈpɒsəbl, hiː plænd tuː dɪsˈkʌs ˈsɛnsɪtɪv ˈtɒpɪks ˈdjʊərɪŋ ə fəʊn kɔːl ɪnˈstɛd/
sentences.text_native: Chaque fois que possible, il prévoyait plutôt de discuter des sujets sensibles lors d'un appel téléphonique.

sentences.text_target: Writing clear messages requires patience, attention, and good formatting habits.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈraɪtɪŋ klɪə ˈmɛsɪʤɪz rɪˈkwaɪəz ˈpeɪʃəns, əˈtɛnʃən, ænd gʊd ˈfɔːmætɪŋ ˈhæbɪts/
sentences.text_native: Rédiger des messages clairs demande de la patience, de l'attention et de bonnes habitudes de mise en forme.

sentences.text_target: His department manager joined the conversation to review the final schedule.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz dɪˈpɑːtmənt ˈmænɪʤə ʤɔɪnd ðə ˌkɒnvəˈseɪʃən tuː rɪˈvjuː ðə ˈfaɪnl ˈʃɛʤuːl/
sentences.text_native: Le responsable de son département s'est joint à la conversation pour examiner le planning final.

sentences.text_target: Together, they confirmed that the important report was ready for the client.
sentences.phonetic: /təˈgɛðə, ðeɪ kənˈfɜːmd ðæt ði ɪmˈpɔːtənt rɪˈpɔːt wɒz ˈrɛdi fɔː ðə ˈklaɪənt/
sentences.text_native: Ensemble, ils ont confirmé que l'important rapport était prêt pour le client.

sentences.text_target: Arthur closed his inbox tab and took a short break to drink some coffee.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːθə kləʊzd hɪz ˈɪnbɒks tæb ænd tʊk ə ʃɔːt breɪk tuː drɪŋk sʌm ˈkɒfi/
sentences.text_native: Arthur a fermé l'onglet de sa boîte de réception et a pris une courte pause pour boire un café.

sentences.text_target: Returning to his desk, he felt relieved that the previous issue was completely resolved.
sentences.phonetic: /rɪˈtɜːnɪŋ tuː hɪz dɛsk, hiː fɛlt rɪˈliːvd ðæt ðə ˈpriːvɪəs ˈɪʃuː wɒz kəmˈpliːtli rɪˈzɒlvd/
sentences.text_native: De retour à son bureau, il s'est senti soulagé que le problème précédent soit complètement résolu.

sentences.text_target: Good communication remains the foundation of a successful working environment.
sentences.phonetic: /gʊd kəˌmjuːnɪˈkeɪʃən rɪˈmeɪnz ðə ˈfaʊndeɪʃən ɒv ə səkˈsɛsfʊl ˈwɜːkɪŋ ɪnˈvaɪərənmənt/
sentences.text_native: Une bonne communication reste le fondement d'un environnement de travail réussi.

sentences.text_target: He turned off his computer at the end of the day, ready for tomorrow's challenges.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː tɜːnd ɒf hɪz kəmˈpjuːtə æt ði ɛnd ɒv ðə deɪ, ˈrɛdi fɔː təˈmɒrəʊz ˈʧælɪnʤɪz/
sentences.text_native: Il a éteint son ordinateur à la fin de la journée, prêt pour les défis de demain.
